thread:
maya (Design): Quick notes from today's compact-panel accessibility check. found issues with shortcut discoverability and focus clarity.
kevin (Frontend): what are the high-level blockers?
maya (Design): 1) the question-mark help icon has no accessible label for screen readers, only a hover tooltip. 2) the shortcuts dialog opens without aria-modal and doesn't trap focus. 3) icon buttons inside the panel have hit areas <44px.
tia (Accessibility): also seen: keycap text on dark bg at ~3.6:1 contrast. needs 4.5:1 for small text or increased weight.
kevin (Frontend): plan: add aria-label/visually-hidden text to the icon, set aria-modal="true" and aria-labelledby on the dialog, implement focus trap + Escape to close, and add .hit-target to expand clickable area via CSS.
kevin (Frontend): CSS proposal: `button.compact:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(30,120,230,0.35); border-radius:6px; } .icon .hit { position:absolute; inset:-6px; }`
tia (Accessibility): prefer box-shadow instead of outline for stable offset. ensure tests cover NVDA/VO behavior.
oliver (DevEx): keep token changes scoped to compact panel; create compact-keycap token to bump contrast without changing global styles. add axe check on PR.
maya (Design): UX note: hover label acceptable, but make sure it's shown on focus too and doesn't cause layout shift — overlay it.
kevin (Frontend): I'll open PRs: semantics+focus trap, CSS fixes, and Playwright e2e + axe snapshot.
a11y-bot: Auto-scan: 4 issues found in /compact-panel: missing aria-modal, missing aria-labelledby, contrast 3.6:1, interactive hit area <44px. Report: https://ci.example/reports/1851000000.
tia (Accessibility): tag me once PRs are up, I'll run manual NVDA/VO passes.
maya (Design): adding checklist: 1) PRs (kevin) 2) Playwright + axe (kevin) 3) manual SR tests (tia) 4) compact token (oliver) 5) ship in patch release.
kevin (Frontend): on it, will post PR links here.
maya (Design): thanks team :sparkles:
